nodes.name: Get SAC Token
nodes.notes: Copy client_id and client_secret from Stage 2 Get SAC Token node. Do not hardcode credentials — move to N8N credentials store before go-live.

nodes.name: Get Top Sellers
nodes.notes: Company-wide sales history — no customer filter. Same endpoint as Stage 2 sales history pull. If >5000 records exist, increase $top or add pagination.

nodes.name: Unpack Top Sellers
nodes.notes: Aggregates raw SAC records by material+sub-family, ranks top 10 per sub-family by total units shipped company-wide. Merges result back into the Stage 1 working object.

nodes.name: Call Claude API (Recommender)
nodes.notes: Uses same Header Auth credential as Stage 1 Claude parser (ID: Heb7OHVfd1A6t1OX). Switch to credential selector in N8N UI — replace x-api-key header value with the credential reference. Model: claude-sonnet-4-6. For testing switch to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 to save cost.

nodes.name: Stage 3 Complete — Output
nodes.notes: Stage 3 return point. Stage 1 Execute Workflow node reads output from here. Returns: aiNarrative (string), recommendedOrder[] (array), plus full enriched working object from Stage 1/2.

parameters.query:
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, ordering_horizon_days, target_weeks_on_hand,
order_frequency, preferred_brands, excluded_categories, customer_group,
case_pack_preference, seasonal_notes, special_notes, notes
FROM iirs_customer_profiles
WHERE customer_id = '{{ $('Stage 3 Trigger').item.json.envelope.customerId }}'
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Get Customer Profile
nodes.notes: Reads ordering profile for this customer from iirs_customer_profiles table. Returns empty if no profile exists — Build Recommender Prompt falls back to defaults (30-day horizon, 4 weeks on hand, as-needed).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO iirs_customer_profiles (
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  customer_group,
  order_frequency,
  ordering_horizon_days,
  target_weeks_on_hand,
  case_pack_preference,
  preferred_brands,
  excluded_categories,
  seasonal_notes
) VALUES (
  '1000001',
  'Example Dealer',
  'Dealer Group',
  'Quarterly',
  60,
  12,
  'Both',
  ARRAY['Alpha', 'Bravo', 'Charlie'],
  ARRAY['Accessories'],
  NULL
);

nodes.name: SETUP — Create Profile Table (run once then disable)
nodes.notes: Run once to create the table, then disable this node. Not connected to any flow — execute manually via right-click > Execute Node.

nodes.name: Build Recommender Prompt Chunked
nodes.notes: Assembles all data signals into Claude prompt. Summarizes customer history by sub-family, submitted items, open orders, opportunity items, and company top sellers.

nodes.name: Parse Recommender Response Chunked
nodes.notes: Extracts narrative and recommendedOrder[] from Claude response. Strips prompt fields and topSellersBySubFamily to keep the return payload lean. On parse error, sets aiNarrative to error message and recommendedOrder to empty array — Stage 1 will still send the HTML report.

parameters.query: SELECT material AS "MATERIAL", description AS "DESCRIPTION", material_type AS "MATERIAL_TYPE", material_group AS "MATERIAL_GROUP", plant AS "PLANT", family AS "FAMILY", mgd2 AS "MGD2", upc AS "UPC" FROM materials WHERE material_type != 'ROH'
